paths.description: Homepage and recent-content feed, representing global navigation, advertising, and the primary discovery surface.
Browse listing, representing the gallery index and filtering/pagination template.
Search results for “fox”, representing the primary search journey and results pagination.
A current public artwork detail page selected from the homepage, representing submission metadata and sharing.
Login form, representing authentication and account entry.
Deliberately missing route, representing HTTP failure and recovery.

findings.summary: Theme is fixed rather than preference-aware.
findings.evidence: Dark and normal screenshots are visually identical, and the CSS probe found no prefers-color-scheme rule or color-scheme declaration.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven light/dark tokens with a user override.

findings.summary: High-contrast preferences are not handled.
findings.evidence: The prefers-contrast screenshot is identical to the normal capture; the CSS probe found no prefers-contrast or forced-colors rules, while Lighthouse found contrast failures.
findings.suggestedFix: Add forced-colors and prefers-contrast adaptations and verify essential text and controls.

findings.summary: Cross-document navigation swaps abruptly.
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS inspection found no view-transition-name or @view-transition usage across this MPA’s browse, search, and detail navigation.
findings.suggestedFix: Add same-origin cross-document View Transitions with reduced-motion fallbacks.

findings.summary: Long feeds provide no scroll-state guidance.
findings.evidence: Mobile layout measured a 9,374px document, but CSS inspection found no scroll-state container query or progress treatment and the header does not respond to position.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a restrained scroll-state-aware header or progress/return affordance for long listings.

findings.summary: Ads and consent obscure the core content.
findings.evidence: Homepage mobile capture shows a large video ad covering the lower feed; search and login captures show a full-page consent dialog before the task.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve non-obscuring ad space and make consent contextual, compact, accessible, and dismissible.

findings.summary: Overlay UI is not built from inspectable page-native semantics.
findings.evidence: The page reports zero dialog, popover, and details elements while custom/third-party overlays handle advertising and consent.
findings.suggestedFix: Use dialog/popover/details for first-party overlays with declarative light-dismiss and focus management.

findings.summary: Advertising chrome competes with content.
findings.evidence: The first mobile viewport devotes large areas to the banner and ad; the ad overlays multiple submission cards.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce banner/ad chrome, reserve stable slots, and prioritize the recent-submissions grid.

findings.summary: Components rely on viewport rules rather than container context.
findings.evidence: CSS inspection across reused gallery, navigation, and form components found no @container or container-type rules.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce container queries for reusable gallery cards, nav, and form groups while retaining fallbacks.

findings.summary: Many targets are too small for touch.
findings.evidence: The focus/target probe found numerous links only 11px high; Lighthouse target-size failed. Native focus outlines were visible.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase interactive target boxes and spacing to at least 24px minimum, preferably 44px for primary mobile controls.

findings.summary: The 404 page is a dead end.
findings.evidence: The intentional 404 returns status 404 and explains the error, but offers only policy links over HTTP and no home, browse, search, or retry action.
findings.suggestedFix: Add clear Home, Browse, Search, and Back actions using HTTPS while preserving the 404 status.

findings.summary: Lab Core Web Vitals are poor.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 5.6s and CLS 0.453 (performance 0.53); trace corroborated FCP 2.55s/LCP 2.64s in a separate warm condition.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP resource, reserve dynamic slots, and retest mobile CWV.

findings.summary: Late content causes substantial layout shift.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured CLS 0.453 with three shifts; all 100 inspected images lacked explicit width/height.
findings.suggestedFix: Set intrinsic dimensions/aspect-ratio for images and ads and use stable font fallbacks.

findings.summary: Render-blocking resources delay content.
findings.evidence: HAR identified parser-inserted styles/scripts; DOM confirmed common.js in head and many body scripts without async/defer. Lighthouse estimates 910ms render-blocking savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer non-critical scripts, inline/minimize critical CSS, optimize font display, and shorten dependency chains.

findings.summary: The homepage ships avoidable legacy and unused code.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 467KiB unused JavaScript and 69KiB unused CSS; HAR shows 764KiB script transfer including video, ad, prebid, and Prototype bundles.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split by page capability, remove Prototype/legacy bundles, and load video/ad code only when needed.

findings.summary: Core images and links lack accessible alternatives.
findings.evidence: Image audit found 100/100 images without alt; Lighthouse also failed image-alt and link-name.
findings.suggestedFix: Add meaningful alt for submissions, empty alt for decorative images, and accessible names for linked images.

findings.summary: Text contrast fails WCAG minimums.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse color-contrast failed on the audited homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust foreground/background tokens and verify normal, hover, disabled, high-contrast, and ad-adjacent states.

findings.summary: Document structure is incomplete.
findings.evidence: Homepage has no H1 and only one nav landmark; Lighthouse reports no main landmark. Focus outlines are visible, but structure is not logical for assistive navigation.
findings.suggestedFix: Add one page H1, main/header/footer landmarks, and preserve the currently visible keyboard focus treatment.

findings.summary: Metadata links are cramped.
findings.evidence: The target probe measured many submission/author links at only 11px high; mobile screenshots show dense, truncated labels.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase type size/line height and provide non-truncated titles or accessible expansion.

findings.summary: Small controls undermine mobile and zoom usability.
findings.evidence: Although 360px layouts do not overflow and scaling is allowed, Lighthouse target-size failed and the probe found many sub-24px controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Use fluid sizing and larger target boxes; test at 200% zoom and narrow reflow.

findings.summary: Assets are structurally unsized and inefficient.
findings.evidence: Doctype/UTF-8 are valid, but image audit found every image missing dimensions, 63 missing srcset, and 100 legacy-format images.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit intrinsic dimensions, responsive sources, and modern formats with fallbacks.

findings.summary: Legacy scripts and missing source maps reduce platform hygiene.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse flags missing source maps and legacy JavaScript; DOM shows Prototype 1.7.3 and several parser-inserted classic scripts.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove stale dependencies, ship modern modules with appropriate fallbacks, and publish production source maps securely.

findings.summary: Canonical and sitemap signals are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Homepage/detail probes found no canonical URL; /sitemap.xml returned 200 with an empty body. robots.txt is present.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish canonical links per public template and a populated, consistent sitemap.

findings.summary: Submission pages lack structured entity metadata.
findings.evidence: The detail page has useful Open Graph tags but zero JSON-LD blocks and uses a generic site-wide meta description.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate VisualArtwork/CreativeWork JSON-LD and a submission-specific meta description.

findings.summary: Transport protections and cookie flags are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Headers audit found no HSTS or nosniff; CSP only sets frame-ancestors. Cookie FCCDCF lacks Secure and uses SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Enable HSTS and nosniff, deploy a nonce/hash-based CSP beyond frame-ancestors, and secure/re-scope cookies.

findings.summary: Advertising creates a broad third-party data surface.
findings.evidence: Consent UI states data may be shared with 210 partners; tracker audit found seven third-party origins and Google Ads, while 44/74 requests and 1.07MB were third-party.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimize vendors and data purposes, block optional requests until consent, and document/batch essential collection.

findings.summary: Authentication is password-only.
findings.evidence: Login exposes username/password fields; no WebAuthn/passkey source was found. No permission request was observed on load.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey authentication and retain password recovery as a fallback.

findings.summary: Several browser-enforced policies are absent.
findings.evidence: Headers audit found no HSTS, Permissions-Policy, or X-Content-Type-Options; clickjacking and Referrer-Policy were present.
findings.suggestedFix: Add HSTS, Permissions-Policy, nosniff, and a fuller CSP/Trusted Types strategy appropriate to the script surface.

findings.summary: Failure recovery is not integrated with the primary journey.
findings.evidence: The 404 is a standalone legacy template with no navigation back to search/browse and policy links use http:// URLs.
findings.suggestedFix: Use the normal resilient shell for errors and provide actionable recovery controls.

findings.summary: Layout is not prepared for bidirectional locales.
findings.evidence: html lang=en is correct, but CSS inspection counted 222 physical left/right declarations and no dir strategy was exposed.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace physical layout properties with logical properties and test dir=rtl; preserve explicit exceptions only where semantic.

findings.summary: Rendered dates are not demonstrably locale-aware.
findings.evidence: The global community page renders English-only relative/server dates, exposes no locale switch, and no locale-aware markup/API signal was found in the inspected page.
findings.suggestedFix: Format dates/numbers with Intl using user locale and machine-readable datetime values.

findings.summary: Server-time output is ambiguous for global users.
findings.evidence: Detail footer prints “Server Time: Jul 19, 2026 07:32 PM” without a time-zone identifier or machine-readable datetime.
findings.suggestedFix: Show localised user time with explicit zone, retain UTC/server time only as secondary diagnostic data.

findings.summary: Login fields do not expose modern validation semantics.
findings.evidence: Username/password inputs are not required and expose no inspected invalid-state semantics; the page gives no pre-submit assistance.
findings.suggestedFix: Use required/autocomplete semantics, validate after interaction, and announce server errors in an accessible summary.

findings.summary: Sign-in autofill is not enabled.
findings.evidence: Login username and password controls have empty autocomplete attributes.
findings.suggestedFix: Add autocomplete=username and autocomplete=current-password, then support passkeys.

findings.summary: Account entry lacks phishing-resistant authentication.
findings.evidence: The public login route offers password plus recovery only and no passkey registration/authentication path was detected.
findings.suggestedFix: Add passkeys, clear reauthentication for sensitive actions, and preserve account recovery.

findings.summary: Image delivery wastes bytes.
findings.evidence: Image audit found 100 legacy-format images, 63 without srcset, and three oversized; Lighthouse estimates 412KiB image savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP responsive variants with srcset/sizes and right-size decorative/banner assets.

findings.summary: Non-core advertising/video code dominates transfer.
findings.evidence: HAR shows 764KiB scripts, including 190KiB ad implementation, 186KiB video, and 111KiB prebid on the homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Load ad/video capabilities conditionally after consent/visibility and deprioritize background fetches.

findings.summary: Third-party cost is disproportionate to the initial task.
findings.evidence: HAR reports 44 third-party requests and 1.07MB third-party transfer out of 1.63MB total; the ad obscures content.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party byte/request budget, remove low-value vendors, and defer media until user intent.

findings.summary: Public content is intentionally unavailable to major AI agents and exposes no structured tools.
findings.evidence: Raw HTML is crawler-visible, but robots.txt disallows GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, and CCBot; no WebMCP/agentic tool registration was observed.
findings.suggestedFix: If agent access is a product goal, define an explicit licensed policy and expose safe read/search capabilities; otherwise document this as intentional.

taskList.title: Fix accessible names, alt text, landmarks, contrast, and target sizing
Stop ads and consent from obscuring primary content
Reserve image/ad space and optimize responsive image delivery
Reduce and defer ad, video, legacy, and unused script
Strengthen headers, cookies, CSP, and third-party minimisation
Repair canonical, sitemap, structured data, and 404 recovery
Add preference, container, scroll-state, and internationalisation support
